rules.statement: A person may mortgage property of which he is not the owner at the time, and when the rights of such a mortgagee come into competition with those of a later mortgagee who took his mortgage after acquisition of title by the mortgagor, the first mortgagee is preferred.
rules.supporting_quote: But, as was held in the case of Goonetilleke v. Jayasekera [1 14 N.L.R. p.65. ], under the Roman-Dutch Law, a person may mortgage property of which he is not the owner at the time and when the rights of such a mortgagee come into competition with those of a later mortgagee, who took his mortgage after acquisition of title by the mortgagor, the first mortgagee is preferred "because the right of pledge was confirmed from the moment of the mortgagor's acquisition of ownership".
